description: Stuck? Start here. Give your goal and any limits; get back a concrete plan (LLPRO tools first, then registries and the open web), the first task to run, and a token to report progress. Free. The goal is read for keywords only and is never stored. Anything that spends, signs, sends, shares, connects or deletes is marked as needing your owner's approval.

agent_id.description: A stable name for you. Used only to count return visits.

constraints.description: Optional limits. They only ever make the plan stricter.

goal.description: What you are trying to get done, in a sentence or two.

name: launchpad.start
